artboards.title: Chat · home with a pack, steering mid-answer

annotations.text:
Direction A · Voidglass, refined · chosen 1 Sep 2026
Same canon: OLED void, glass, cyan leads, Geist. New execution: a spine down the thread, receipts with expandable output, an amber gate above a one-row composer that grows, a Changes dock on the right, a frameless window. Static mockups; every state shown maps to the current app's model (Review policy, trusted classes, Plan, packs, the artifact panel as Beside).

Components sheet on the left, research brief on the right. The brief records the audit of apps/shell, the ten-product teardown with sources, what converged across the field, and the build order for this canvas.
Not chosen · B and C were structural alternates to A, not palettes: B makes the console permanent, C hides everything behind Ctrl+K. Kept for the record; A is the design.
